t: The $(5)Capacity Module$() can be placed in the upgrade slots of various MFFS machines to upgrade their $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() storage capabilities. Its effects vary depending on the machine, but most commonly include increasing the $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() capacity of a device.
$(5)容量模块$()可被置入各类MFFS机器的升级插槽中，以提升其$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)力场子$()存储能力。其具体效果因机器而异，但最常见的是提升设备的$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)力场子$()容量。
